answer: Each new agent must lock a 5,000-token bond before its first vote, and the bond stays locked for ten epochs while peers grade its work. A farm of 100 fakes ties up 500,000 tokens and must wait out the whole voyage before any payout, so the attack costs far more than it can earn. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, because every wallet still posts its own bond. The public bond log works as a lantern: anyone can see which keys paid. An honest agent pays once and gets the full bond back at the summit of its probation, after ten clean epochs.
